verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents customizable notifications for recurring obligations such as annual penetration testing and quarterly access reviews (docs-13). It also surfaces overdue tasks (docs-9) and supports custom fields on Tasks (docs-25), which together suggest a recurring task-and-reminder workflow that touches some manual artifacts. It does not explicitly cover a manual-evidence workflow with per-artifact owners, due dates, and expiry tracking. Missing for 10: explicit manual evidence upload workflow, owner assignment per manual artifact, expiry/renewal tracking on each artifact, independent or hands-on corroboration.
